title: Local console access policy
responsibility: Admits local owner requests only when owner mode, loopback binding and the actual peer address all qualify.

inputs.name: loopbackAddress.address
inputs.description: The address to test; undefined is read as the empty string and never matches. After trimming and lowercasing, the value must equal localhost, ::1, 127.x.y.z or ::ffff:127.x.y.z, with each of x, y and z one to three digits and no range check (127.999.0.1 matches; 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1 does not).

inputs.name: consolePolicy.owner
inputs.description: The owner configuration, read once when consolePolicy is called, so later edits to the object have no effect. The policy is enabled only when mode is exactly 'loopback', bind passes the loopbackAddress check, and addressHeader is absent or blank after trimming; a nonblank addressHeader disables it entirely.

outputs.name: loopbackAddress
outputs.description: True when the trimmed, lowercased address is localhost, ::1, 127.x.y.z or ::ffff:127.x.y.z (one to three digits per octet, no range check), and false otherwise, including when the input is undefined. consolePolicy applies this same check to the address returned by getClientAddress.

outputs.name: consolePolicy
outputs.description: The per-request policy: each call returns true only when the owner configuration was enabled at construction and event.getClientAddress is present and returns a loopback address, and false otherwise, including when getClientAddress is missing or throws. It returns a plain boolean synchronously, never a Promise, and reads no request header, Host value or URL.

outputs.name: denyAll
outputs.description: The default policy for any host that has not supplied one; it ignores its argument and always returns false, synchronously.
